leads.title: Republic of Congo Family Code, Section 2, Article 127
leads.documents: Explicit ban on same-sex marriage; defines marriage as lasting union between a man and a woman

leads.title: Law No. 27-2020 on the Fight against Cybercrime, Article 19
leads.documents: Limited data-privacy protection based on sexual orientation; prohibits storing data revealing sexual orientation without legal exception or consent, punishable by 1-5 years prison and/or 1M-10M CFA francs fine
leads.detail: Cited inline as 'Article 19 of Law No. 27-2020'; no URL visible in provided text
